name: Ink
one_line: A pen-and-ink drawing on paper: boiling outlines and hatching in the shadows.

hatching.help: Pen strokes in the shadows. 0 = none.
hatching.label: Hatching

hatchFrom.help: How dark a place must be before it gets hatched. Higher = more hatching.
hatchFrom.label: Hatch from

wobble.help: How much the lines shake, in pixels. 0 = still, ruled lines.
wobble.label: Line wobble

paper.help: How much the paper colour soaks into the picture.
paper.label: Paper tint

orthographic.note: Checked on the platformer starter: outlines and paper work. Lines do not thin with distance there (everything is at one distance).

measured.how: hidden Chromium on the kit's test laptop, whole frame read back from the graphics chip; machine load changes it
